rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for allocating or apportioning resources, including legal or wealth-related allocation.

example.english: The company’s year-end distribution gives bonuses to employees.
example.traditional: 公司年尾會分配花紅畀員工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 nin4 mei5 wui5 fan1 pui3 faa1 hung4 bei2 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the business process of getting products through wholesalers, retailers, and other sales channels to consumers.

example.english: This company handles the distribution of this drink throughout Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢間公司負責分銷呢款飲品去全港各區。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 fu6 zaak3 fan1 siu1 ni1 fun2 jam2 ban2 heoi3 cyun4 gong2 gok3 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for an individual portion or share rather than the process of distributing things.

example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 fan1 je5 jau5 ngo5 go2 fan6

rows.note: Use this in statistical or mathematical contexts for the pattern of relative likelihoods across possible values.

example.english: This graph shows the distribution of this data set.
example.traditional: 呢張圖顯示呢組數據嘅分布。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 hin2 si6 ni1 zou2 sou3 geoi3 ge3 fan1 bou3
